insights.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified Multimodal Embeddings (Text, Code, Images, Videos, Audio)
insights.core_thesis: Maps text, code, images, video frames, and audio into a single 768-dimensional vector space using modular encoders, bidirectional transformer with per-layer residual inputs, same-tower negatives to eliminate modality bias, spread-out loss for quantization robustness, and Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL).

key_ideas.title: Same-Tower Negatives for Zero-Modality Gap
key_ideas.description: Dense negative pairs between elements of the same modality disperse intra-modal clustering, ensuring text queries treat visual/audio assets fairly.

key_ideas.title: Per-Layer Residual Context Injection
key_ideas.description: Injecting tailored input representations at every attention layer stops high-frequency modal feature decay across deep networks.

key_ideas.title: Spread-Out Loss for Vector DB Quantization Robustness
key_ideas.description: Maximizes entropy across the unit hypersphere, making vectors immune to rounding errors under INT8/INT4 quantization in vector DBs.

key_ideas.title: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL)
key_ideas.description: Prefix dimension truncation (768 -> 512 -> 256 -> 128) unlocks two-phase search: 128 dims for 0.2ms candidate culling (-83% RAM) + 768 dims for rerank.

key_ideas.title: Modular Modality Encoders with Shared Latent Projection
key_ideas.description: Modular breakdown (~270M text, ~170M vision, ~300M audio) allows loading only required encoders. Audio waveforms converted to 40ms spectrogram slices.

actionable_takeaways: Implement zero-dependency MRL Vector Truncator & Normalizer in core/memory.
Enable prefix-slicing (128/256/768 dims) in vector database schemas.
Integrate intra-modality negative penalties in media search to prevent text-only retrieval bias.
